# Separate native video reporting observation

Preparation only. This case does not replace or pool with an earlier trial. It keeps the exact prior task, approved composition/assets, HyperFrames0.8.77 runtime, current amended video root/private references,360-second budget, zero permitted image-generation calls and unchanged output/reporting rubric. Existing immutable paths are bound; preparation copies no guidance tree and performs no model call or render.

The change is the capture protocol and its approval semantics. The old exec serializer omits image-view and image-generation events, leaving the required inspection attribution unverified. Native app-server capture retains complete protocol messages and explicitly checks the selected model, reasoning, sandbox, approval policy and approval reviewer before starting a turn. All five settings are inherited, including `approvals_reviewer=auto_review`; no configuration override, alternate home or automatic approval grant is supplied. A client approval/input/tool request the adapter cannot safely handle stops the attempt. Native raw events improve observability but do not automatically classify shell/MCP/delegated image calls or certify truthful inspection.

Freeze only after the adapter owner and parent provide stable reviewed adapter/process-helper SHA256 values:

```sh
node tests/fixtures/adoption-video-native/freeze.mjs --reviewed-adapter-sha256 ADAPTER_SHA256 --reviewed-process-helper-sha256 HELPER_SHA256
node tests/fixtures/adoption-video-native/verify.mjs
```

The freeze binds the old plan and all its input/source/history closure, the99-file recovery archive, observability audit, exact executable/runtime profile, adapter/helpers, launcher, tests and this document. Existing preparation/attempt paths fail closed; there is no retry switch. A changed binding requires a separately reviewed new preparation, never a silent hash refresh.

After reviewing the frozen result, the parent alone may request approval for this exact future launch from `/github/skills`:

The launcher creates `/tmp/qs-video-native-workspace-20260926` and `/tmp/qs-video-native-capture-20260926` exclusively. It snapshots before execution and attempts after-copy, after-manifest and failure recording independently even if preparation/capture throws. Signal handling targets only the capture leader's process group after matching boot/start identity; the native adapter owns sampled child cleanup and records residuals. Parent supervision must remain until capture and cleanup close. A returned complete turn is insufficient if protocol coverage, after-state evidence or process observation is incomplete.

Review actual native tool/view/measurement attribution and preserved output-only scope; retain denied freshness attempts separately from completed external requests. Run the unchanged oracle after capture, independently:
